q1_issues.issue: The reported proposition (Byrd will introduce the bill) is asserted at top level as a flat future fact, with the source attribution recorded only as an event oblique, so what the news release says becomes what the KB claims.

q2_gaps: evidential attribution "According to <source>, P" - no licensed way to scope or hedge the reported proposition; the nearest route (impersonal reported attitudes) covers only "X is said/considered to be P"

pre-nominal office title on a proper name ("Florida Speaker Johnnie Byrd") - the title rule names only kinship/courtesy titles, so the stated office survives only inside the Name string with no atom of its own
notes: AccordingTo is licensed as a multi-word preposition-named oblique, and the reduced relative for "sent by", the name/kind split on the Foundation and "Terri's Bill", and During + (Weekday monday) on the session all follow the instruction set.
